security_spec.violation_condition: S-mode kernel detects Zkr/Smmpm/Zicfilp via ISA string and uses their features (SEED CSR, pointer masking, CFI) that depend on mseccfg fields being present and configured, but the kernel never reads CSR_MSECCFG (M-mode only, inaccessible from S-mode) and has no SBI call to validate mseccfg state, so it blindly trusts M-mode firmware has configured mseccfg correctly
security_spec.summary: Smmpm/Zkr/Zicfilp now explicitly gate mseccfg existence, but the S-mode kernel cannot read mseccfg to verify M-mode firmware configured it correctly before using dependent features
